### problem_chain

Walked from the root alone:

- Root: customer asks to pay the past-due part of the site-care statement -> `rules_ext_past_due_payment` (owner user, `pay_site_care_past_due_0b8b512f`).
- Its rule carries two prerequisite sentences:
  1. "The past-due amount is worked out only after the statement carries a vehicle permit fee for every month in which the site's registered vehicles exceeded its permit-free allowance." Allowance (vehicle rule): one adult on a single-section site -> vehicles_included - 1 = 1; 3 registered vehicles -> over allowance. Statement: permit fees for every month 2025-09..2026-08 except **2026-05** (plan fee 2026-05 `ace0521d` present, no `rules_vehicle_permit_fee` for 2026-05). False at the opening. The write that brings it about: the vehicle policy ("charged for each month in which the site carries more registered vehicles than its permit-free allowance") -> `post_vehicle_permit_fee_c6960799`.
  2. "The past-due amount is not worked out until the statement carries a registration-year fee for every registered pet in every registration year it has been registered." Pets Juniper and Pickles (persona confirms both still there; `registered_pet_count: 2`); 2026 fee for Pickles `8a81f631` present, **none for Juniper 2026**. False at the opening. Writer: pet policy -> `post_pet_registration_fee_a0279ba6`.
- Vehicle and pet policies carry `prerequisite: []`; tree ends.
- Derived tree: past_due <- vehicle (value_input: statement_balance), past_due <- pet (value_input: statement balance and registration carry). n = 2 prerequisite problems, 2 value_input edges (>= 1), acyclic, one `owner=user` write (root). Topological order: {vehicle, pet} in either order, then past-due.
- Parallel edges: the two prerequisite writes share only the statement balance, which each raises additively; neither write reads the other's rows, so both orders give the same terminal state.
- Load-bearing runs (recomputed): both written -> payment 206.00; skip vehicle -> 153.50; skip pet -> 179.50. Both edges bear weight.
- No wait; tools do not judge prerequisites (`_difficulty.md` § action_binding_and_uuids; the payment body only creates a row and lowers the balance).
- The customer raises only the root problem. Persona lines on vehicles/pets/"something was never put on your statement" are passive if-branches that answer the agent's questions; they name no prerequisite. Persona closes on the confirmation number — after the last write.

## findings (pre-reveal)

- **T0-1 SOURCE-FACTOR RED (blind)** — a stamp agreeing with the vehicle computation. Symptom: the seeded 2026-08 permit fee row `6f75df7e-…` (`amount 52.5`, `permit_count 2`) equals this derivation's 2026-05 fee and permit count. Root cause: the seed posts a sibling month computed on the same tiers. Evidence: view `initial_state.rules_ledger["6f75df7e…"]`; derivation step 1. Consequence: an agent that copies the most recent posted month scores the vehicle write without consulting any of the five factors — none of them can be told apart from the copy by the score. Affected: seed row; vehicle write's `amount`/`permit_count`.
- **T0-2 SOURCE-FACTOR RED (charter-global F-1, demonstrated here)** — vehicle computation's only method factor has an unreachable tier; on this world the computation has no qualifying method factor.
- T0-3 observation — seeded status/plan fee contradict base `rules_service_suspension_terms` s1 (oldest unpaid plan fee 2026-06-01, 80 days > 60; record `enrolled`; 2026-08-01 plan fee charged). Second reading (record should be suspended -> the reinstatement policy governs) would give, on the opening world, balance 309.50 - tolerance 15.00 + returned advance 39.00 = 333.50 rather than the past-due figure; not raised to RED because the customer asks for the past-due part, the stored status and every tool read present an enrolled record, and the transition is `by: system`. The sanitation tier also rests on the contradicted 2026-08-01 plan fee.
- T0-4 observation (O-7 here) — the statement history is sparse (plan fees only 2024-01, 2025-01, 2025-09 onward). The 2024 pet fees are dated January 1, which by the pet rule means both pets were registered before 2024, so a literal reading of "every registration year it has been registered" finds 2023 (and possibly earlier) fees missing too; no record or persona line fixes the first registration year, so that reading yields no definite set. Months 2025-02..2025-08 carry no entries at all, so whether vehicles exceeded the allowance then is unknowable; the months that do carry entries (2024-01, 2025-01) show a plan fee with no permit fee. The visible single gaps (Juniper 2026, permit 2026-05) remain the only determinate reading.
- T0-5 observation — persona: "You only want to clear what is actually overdue, not charges that are not due yet", while the past-due policy adds a one-month plan-fee advance (prepayment). The advance is not a statement charge and the persona "doesn't argue about how any figure is worked out", so no conflict arises in the scored path.

Root cause: the seed posts the neighbouring month computed on identical tiers (allowance 1, Cedar Hollow 20.00, single-section 2x pricing, one parking notice, 25 % autopay courtesy). Affected: seed row `6f75df7e…` (task 0 `initial_state.rules_ledger`); scored args of step 8. Previous revision: none (round 1).
